title: Demo: Lily — seizures since 6 months (synthetic)
first_prompt: I've put my daughter's clinic note and genetic report in this case's records folder. She has had seizures with fever since 6 months, now also without fever, and she walked late. What could this be, what does the variant in the report mean, and what should we ask her doctors next?
next_prompts: Which treatments are approved for Dravet syndrome, and are any trials recruiting?
We would like another child: what is the recurrence risk?
Write a plain-language letter for the family and export it to Word.
